question:
Which of the following letter-clusters will replace the question mark (?) in the given series to make it logically complete?

VRM 9 WTJ 6 XVG 3 YXD 0 ?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7ca63fa0a9b1d8d94e9032be998e74b7faff301d8847e785439c04e89b02dfd4.png] 

The logic followed here is:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/a611cbf8ec865af1baaee19447533f3a205cba1c08a4be7156a49eb6bd818761.png] [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/982bacc8bb3999f3bf138594a10380b801b45b472017cfac4e960a55f120a201.png] 

So, **'ZZA -3' **will replace the question mark in the given series.

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 1".
